{{Top|leg}}
The '''Military Dome''' was one of the large spherical modules of the [[Kuat Passenger Port]]. It was responsible for dealing with flights originating from, and heading towards, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] installations. Military passengers transferred from Imperial vessels to civilian commercial traffic at the Military Dome. It was also the prime arrival and departure point for personnel transferred to the [[Imperial Transfer Post]] and other military facilities in the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]].
